proof_body:
by
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ : ∃ r, p = r + 2 := ⟨p - 2, by omega⟩
  have e : LucasLehmer.LucasLehmerTest (r + 2) ↔ ((2 ^ (r + 2) - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ LucasLehmer.s (r + 2 - 2) := by
    unfold LucasLehmer.LucasLehmerTest LucasLehmer.lucasLehmerResidue
    rw [LucasLehmer.sZMod_eq_s]
    exact CharP.intCast_eq_zero_iff (ZMod (2 ^ (r + 2) - 1)) (2 ^ (r + 2) - 1) _
  rw [← e]
  exact ⟨fun h => lucas_lehmer_necessity (r + 2) hp h, fun h => lucas_lehmer_sufficiency (r + 2) (by omega) h⟩
target_source: ∀ p : ℕ, 3 ≤ p → (Nat.Prime (2 ^ p - 1) ↔ ((2 ^ p - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ LucasLehmer.s (p - 2))
